subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in a user-visible A2A path that CI cannot fully settle across all real channel histories.

options.title: Accept The Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the new Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for an additional redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run before merge if deterministic QA proof is not enough.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want this mirror fix bundled with the reverse sessions_send and compaction duplicate work.

recommendation.title: Accept The Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the new Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.
